In the margin he cites a lost manuscript titled 'Quadripartitus' (Blas Forf, III and VI As, Ordal, III Atr, Pax Wal, Swer, Wer, Wl lad, Geþyncðo, Rect) whose readings match no known Quadripartitus codex.

entries.text_de:
British Museum Cotton Julius C II10, Abschrift und Excerpt des Franc. Tate um 1589—1613 aus H: f. 42 Abt, u. S. 3; f. 45 Wi, u. S. 12; f. 46b Blas, u. S. 388; Ordal, u. S. 386; f. 47 Wal, u. S. 392; f. 47b Pax, u. S. 390; f. 48 wieder Abt; Hl, u. S. 9; f. 50 Swer, u. S. 396; f. 50b Að, u. S. 464; Mirce, u. S. 462; f. 51 Urkunden ebendaher11.

Ferner aus G: f. 52 IV Atr, u. S. 232; f. 54 Grið, u. S. 470; f. 56b VIII Atr, u. S. 263; Theile der Polity.

Aus H: Wer, u. S. 393; f. 58b III Atr, u. S. 228; f. 60 Wl lad, u. S. 483; f. 60b VI As, u. S. 173.

F. 64b III As, u. S. 170 inter leges Athelstani in libro Henry Sidnei12 d. presidentis Wallie.

Dann aus H: f. 65 In Cn, u. S. 612, nur Theile; f. 66 Iud Dei III, u. S. 408; Gyf feoh, u. S. 444 Sp. 11; f. 66b Becwæð, u. S. 400; f. 67 aus B Rect, u. S. 444; aus H Geþyncðo, u. S. 457; f. 67v. In Cn III 60.

Am Rande citirt der Excerptor ein uns verlorenes, ‘Quadripartitus’ betiteltes Exemplar, welches enthielt: f. 29 Blas Forf; 32 III As; 33 VI As; 36 Ordal; 37b III Atr; 38b Pax Wal; 51b Swer; 52b Wer; 53 Wl lad; Geþyncðo; 56 Rect. Zu keinem Quadr.-Codex stimmen die Lesarten genau.
entries.text_en:
British Museum Cotton Julius C II10, transcript and excerpt by Franc. Tate, c. 1589—1613, from H: f. 42 Abt, below, p. 3; f. 45 Wi, below, p. 12; f. 46b Blas, below, p. 388; Ordal, below, p. 386; f. 47 Wal, below, p. 392; f. 47b Pax, below, p. 390; f. 48 Abt again; Hl, below, p. 9; f. 50 Swer, below, p. 396; f. 50b Að, below, p. 464; Mirce, below, p. 462; f. 51 charters from the same source11.

Further, from G: f. 52 IV Atr, below, p. 232; f. 54 Grið, below, p. 470; f. 56b VIII Atr, below, p. 263; parts of the Polity.

From H: Wer, below, p. 393; f. 58b III Atr, below, p. 228; f. 60 Wl lad, below, p. 483; f. 60b VI As, below, p. 173.

F. 64b III As, below, p. 170, inter leges Athelstani in libro Henry Sidnei12 d. presidentis Wallie.

Then from H: f. 65 In Cn, below, p. 612, only parts; f. 66 Iud Dei III, below, p. 408; Gyf feoh, below, p. 444, col. 11; f. 66b Becwæð, below, p. 400; f. 67 from B Rect, below, p. 444; from H Geþyncðo, below, p. 457; f. 67v. In Cn III 60.

In the margin the excerptor cites a copy, lost to us, entitled ‘Quadripartitus’, which contained: f. 29 Blas Forf; 32 III As; 33 VI As; 36 Ordal; 37b III Atr; 38b Pax Wal; 51b Swer; 52b Wer; 53 Wl lad; Geþyncðo; 56 Rect. The readings agree exactly with no Quadr. codex.

notes.text_de: Sonstigen Inhalt s. Catal. of the Cotton. (1802) p. 8.
notes.text_en: For other contents see Catal. of the Cotton. (1802) p. 8.

notes.text_de: Die Urkunde Wilhelm's I. für Lanfranc, betr. Facenham, druckt Giles Scriptores rer. gest. Will. Conq. p. 178. Über Tate vgl. Dict. nat. biogr.
notes.text_en: The charter of William I for Lanfranc, concerning Facenham, is printed by Giles, Scriptores rer. gest. Will. Conq. p. 178. On Tate cf. Dict. nat. biogr.

notes.text_de: Bei den Nachkommen Sidney's habe ich vergeblich diesen Quadr. erfragt. Sein Sohn war Viscount L'Isle Graf Leicester.
notes.text_en: I have enquired in vain among Sidney's descendants for this Quadr. His son was Viscount L'Isle, Earl of Leicester.

transcription.doubts: 'Sp. 1<sup>1</sup>' after 'u. S. 444': the superscript 1 refers to note 1 on p. 444 (not a footnote of this page). In the list of the lost 'Quadripartitus' the code names are printed in roman, not bold.
proof_notes: text_de: bold 'In Cn III 60' → 'In Cn III 60' (III 60 roman; p. xxxi col. 2)

wormald.shelfmark: London, British Library, Cotton MS Julius C.ii
wormald.wormald_origin: Francis Tate wrote the note on f. 52r (formerly ascribed to Lambarde) (p. 225 nn. 245–6). (Liebermann's guide: transcripts by Tate, c. 1589–1613.)
wormald.laws: Transcript of V Atr and Grið (traced to Joscelyn's copy)
wormald.laws_liebermann: Abt, Wi, Blas, Ordal, Wal, Pax, Hl, Swer, Að, Mirce, IV Atr, Grið, VIII Atr, Wer, III Atr, Wl lad, VI As, III As, In Cn, Iud Dei, Becwæð, Rect, Geþyncðo, Quadr
wormald.overview: An early modern volume of transcripts (Liebermann ascribes them to Francis Tate). A note by Tate on f. 52r, once thought to be Lambarde's, traces its copy of V Æthelred and Grið to a manuscript Joscelyn held by November 1580; Wormald takes this to show that Joscelyn seems then to have had Nero A.i(B), and that Lambarde had probably seen it by that date.
wormald.key_quote: is now known to be by Tate not Lambarde (p. 225 n. 246)
wormald.guide_shelfmark: London, British Library, Cotton MS Julius C.ii
verify_notes: Checked p. 225 nn. 245–6. Overview: 'A volume of Francis Tate's transcripts' is the guide's (Liebermann's) description, not Wormald's — now labelled; Joscelyn's possession of Nero A.i(B) softened to Wormald's 'seems'.
